meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 在 xAI 已连接时,Claude 会用 x_search 工具搜 X(推特)帖子:按日期限定时效性查询、只搜你指定的可信账号、拆成 2~3 条窄查询,并与 web_search 结果对照,汇报时附上 x.com 链接并标明出处。
howto.when: 当你提到 X 搜索、Twitter 搜索、推文等关键词,或要求查 X 上的讨论时触发;原文写明只在 xAI 已连接时有效,否则会说明不可用并改用 web_search。

say.text: 帮我搜 X 上最近一天关于 NVDA 的讨论,只看我信任的那几个账号
say.note: 按日期限定并用 allowed_x_handles 缩小范围

say.text: X 上大家对这次新品发布有什么反应?顺便用 web_search 对照一下
say.note: 同一轮跑 X 与网页两条线并做对照

say.text: 把这条推文的回复和引用也拉出来看看
say.note: 只对单条帖子拉取回复与引用

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude searches X (Twitter) through x_search: it date-bounds time-sensitive queries, scopes trusted accounts, splits work into 2-3 narrow queries, and reconciles against web_search, citing x.com URLs and labelling sources as X posts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X and similar terms, or ask what people are saying on X while xAI is connected; if no credential exists it says so and falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for the last day of posts on NVDA, limited to the accounts I trust
say_en.note: Runs a handle pass with from_date and allowed_x_handles

say_en.text: What are people saying on X about the launch? Check web_search too
say_en.note: Runs both lanes in one turn, then reconciles

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this one post
